STOP GENERATING STATUS REPORTS.

Execute only the following verification.

1. Verify GitHub HEAD SHA.
2. Verify the Render production SHA.
3. Verify the runtime SHA from the production application (/health or /version).
4. Confirm all three SHAs are identical.
5. If any mismatch exists, identify exactly where it occurs and correct it.
6. Verify the production source is synchronized with GitHub.

Return only:

- GitHub HEAD SHA
- Render production SHA
- Runtime SHA
- SHA parity: YES/NO
- Production synchronized: YES/NO
- Exact blocker (if any)

Do not repeat previous reports.
Do not return a plan.
Provide only evidence.
